column1: # Hardware profiles for tools/survey/survey.py: what each count may take on a kind of machine.
#   ram_gb            the machine's memory; three quarters of it is shared by the counts running at once
#   cores             the most counts that run at once (fewer if their filter memory will not fit)
#   filter_memory_mb  what one count's tables may take: the setup menu's FILTER MEMORY (512 MB at first)
#   time_limit_s      how long one count may take before it is recorded as over time
# Any of them can be overridden on the command line (--ram-gb, --cores, --filter-memory, --time-limit).
